analysis.scope: 76 actual newly executed native goals:16 preparation,12 explicit restart warmups,48 held-out. One two-CPU/512MiB budget,12 nearby synthetic tasks,three rotating four-task blocks per policy. Fresh outcome checks retained. Model and bank fixed. Every block performs a real cold-proof memory goal and a full model read, including simple-control blocks; show those study overheads separately from task costs. Copies reuse preparation evidence; they are not new observations. No randomization, physical accuracy, probability, general improvement or unobserved horizon claim.
